UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Google user profile isolated strictly to the account owner.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: Persistent cross-device Jarvis conversation thread owned by a single user.

ownerId.description: Immutable UID of the user who owns this chat session.

messageCount.description: Total messages stored in this session.

ChatMessageDoc.title: ChatMessageDoc
ChatMessageDoc.description: Individual user or Jarvis message inside a ChatSession.

ownerId.description: Immutable UID of the conversation owner.

sourcesJson.description: JSON-serialized array of grounded web citations.

isOfflineGenerated.description: Whether the reply was generated by the local offline neural core.

clientOrder.description: Monotonic millisecond sequence number for deterministic ordering.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document accessible exclusively by userId.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Cross-device chat history threads owned by userId.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Ordered messages belonging to a specific chat session.
